chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Abu Malik al-Juhani, from al-Hasan ibn 'Umarah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) offered the sacrifice (Qurbani) with a one-year-old male sheep, which was white and had a defect in its horns.

key_terms.أَجْذَعَ: One-year-old (specifically referring to age and horn condition)

ai.seo_question: What were the physical characteristics of the animal Prophet Muhammad used for sacrifice?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* details the specific physical attributes of the ram sacrificed by the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), emphasizing its whiteness, fatness, and a specific horn defect (ajdha'). In Shia jurisprudence, this hadith serves as a primary evidence for the permissibility of sacrificing animals with minor defects, provided they are otherwise healthy and suitable for consumption, thereby distinguishing between valid and invalid defects in ritual slaughter.
